text:
Liam: Heads-up — integration cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. Changes touching API, runtime, console, router. We need a compatibility gating plan and explicit pins. @deploy-bot can you schedule?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy "integration-cutover-2026-03-23" to start at 23:00 UTC. Canary: 5% for 20m -> promote on healthy checks. Will post updates.

Maria: Do NOT deploy console UI changes until runtime supports X-Request-TTL header; older routers drop streaming ws frames.

Sasha: Runtime PR #432 (merged to canary) adds that header. Not promoted to prod yet. I propose: promote runtime first, then router pinning, then console.

Liam: Proposed plan:
1) Start runtime canary (5% / 20m). Verify health/latency.
2) If green -> promote runtime.
3) Pin router to 1.9.2 for a 2h window (so console traffic hits compatible router).
4) Deploy console changes behind a feature flag.
If any step fails -> rollback to previous runtime image and unpin router.

ops-oncall: Rollback triggers: error rate >1% sustained over 5m, or p95 latency >500ms sustained 3m, or KV-cache-miss spike >2x baseline. I'll be watching and will call the rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary update: runtime-canary (image:runtime:2026.03.23-canary) healthy checks 12/12, p50 45ms, p95 210ms. Proceed with promotion? :white_check_mark:

Sasha: I'll kick promotion now. Also adding a short probe endpoint for streaming health:
```
curl -fsS -H "X-Request-TTL: 60" https://runtime.prod.internal/health/stream
# expected 200 + "stream_ok"
```

DevEx: Heads-up — console change requires SDK bump to 2.4.1 for the new structured outputs. We'll coordinate release notes/CHANGELOG.

Sam: I'll open PR to pin router image and add rollback playbook steps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987

Maria: I'll hold the console deployment until you confirm runtime promotion + router pin applied. Also adding a short note in release notes about expected 2h router pin.

Liam: Sounds good. @ops-oncall please ack when monitoring is set. If green by 23:30 UTC we promote console to 10% flag release. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Acked. Monitoring dashboards up and alert thresholds configured. I'll post if anything trips.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: runtime promoted to prod at 1973456950. Router pin applied to svc/router-prod -> image:router:1.9.2 at 1973456985. Canary window closed.

Liam: Thanks everyone. We'll keep the pin for 2h and then unpin at 01:30 UTC unless issues. I'll follow up with a short release note update after the final unpin.

Maria: Added note to release notes doc and QA checklist. All good from my side.

Sasha: Leaving a short postmortem template in the PR in case we needed rollback.

DevEx: Noted — coordinating SDK publish for 2.4.1. ETA 00:15 UTC.

Liam: Great job — closing this thread when router is unpinned. :rocket
